title: Prototype model-serving stack with Serving Monitor

nodes.label: Client Application
nodes.description: Sends user inference requests to the model-serving stack and displays the generated responses to the user.

nodes.label: Model API
nodes.description: Accepts inference requests, invokes the backing model to generate responses, and returns the results to the caller.

nodes.label: Foundation Model
nodes.description: Generates output for each inference request; may be a third-party hosted API or a self-hosted model.

nodes.label: Serving Monitor
nodes.description: Collects per-request latency and token-usage metrics from the Model API so operators can observe serving health and cost.

nodes.label: Metrics Store
nodes.description: Persists the latency and usage metrics captured by the Serving Monitor for later inspection.

assumptions: The system serves inference requests from client applications through a single model API backed by a self-hosted or third-party foundation model.
The Serving Monitor records latency and token-usage metrics per request for prototype-level observability.
No guardrails, caching, routing, or feedback loops are included at prototype maturity.
User authentication, billing, and rate limiting are out of scope for the prototype.
